title: 第300章 你来挖
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

田曼琪面无表情地望向他：

“活下去和吃人肉自己选。”

那人陷入了纠结中。

“你们几个去拾柴，你们几个挑个肥的拽过来，用刀切成小块，我这有打火机，一会儿烤着吃。”

田曼琪没有计较刚刚那群人的抱怨，语气平静地指挥众人，毕竟她还需要他们干活。

见田曼琪把话说得好似要吃的肉是猪肉一般，大伙犹豫又挣扎。

可终于有第一个人迈出了一步，他一步一步走向尸体，拽住了其中一具尸体的右脚，其他人也上前，沉默着将人拽了过来。

一个小时后，40多人吃饱喝足，胃里消化着刚刚进入的油脂。

田曼琪望向天空，摸着鼓起来的肚子：

“吃饱的感觉真好。”

稍作休息，田曼琪环顾河岸四周，寻找白天能避暑的地方。

四周空旷，大树也光秃秃的，没有任何东西能遮挡阳光。

田曼琪回想下洼村庇护所的山洞，建在山壁上。

她命令其他人拿着铁锹，跟她往远处的山壁走。

山壁大多是土壤，用铁锹一挖就能挖动。

田曼琪从人群里点出5个身体强壮的：

“一人挖一个小时，你们5个先来。”

那五人不情不愿。

有人开口：“凭什么让我们先来？”

田曼琪冷着脸：“我说什么，你照做就是了，哪来那么多不愿意和不服气？”

她的庇护所大梦彻底成为泡沫，心里正烦躁着呢，这群蠢货也让她不顺心。

“你还当自己是领头的吗？要不是因为你，我们不可能落到今天这个下场！就应该你赎罪，你来挖！”

一人把铁锹扔到田曼琪脚边，直接罢工。

“你！”

田曼琪气极，平日里这帮人极为听话，她说东没人敢说西。

现在怎么指使他们挖个洞都这么费劲？

她强迫自己冷静下来，压制住心中的怒火：

“我知道你们心中对我有怨气，但现在重要的是保命！我们只有团结起来，挖出抵抗高温的山洞，才能存活下去。”

刚刚扔铁锹那人皮笑肉不笑地看着田曼琪：

“行啊，我们可以团结，但前提是你先挖！”

他一路上看到，田曼琪总知道指使别人，自己却什么都不干。

Page (1/3)

Tian Manqi looked at him expressionlessly:

"It's your choice to live or eat human flesh."

The man was confused.

"You guys go collect firewood. You guys pick a fat one and pull it over and cut it into small pieces with a knife. I have a lighter here and I will roast it and eat it later."

Tian Manqi didn't care about the complaints of the group just now, and commanded everyone in a calm tone. After all, she still needed them to work.

Seeing Tian Manqi talking as if the meat she wanted to eat was pork, everyone hesitated and struggled.

But finally the first person took a step. He walked towards the corpses step by step and grabbed the right foot of one of the corpses. The others also stepped forward and silently pulled the person over.

An hour later, more than 40 people had eaten and drank enough, and their stomachs were digesting the fat that had just entered.

Tian Manqi looked at the sky and touched her bulging belly:

“It feels so good to be full.”

After taking a short rest, Tian Manqi looked around the river bank, looking for a place to escape the heat during the day.

The surrounding area was empty, the trees were bare, and there was nothing to block the sunlight.

Tian Manqi recalled the cave in the shelter in Xiawa Village, which was built on the mountain wall.

She ordered the others to take shovels and follow her to the distant mountain wall.

Most of the mountain walls are soil, which can be dug with a shovel.

Tian Manqi named 5 strong people from the crowd:

"You can dig for an hour each, the five of you come first."

The five people were reluctant.

Someone said: "Why should we come first?"

Tian Manqi said with a cold face: "Just do what I say, why are there so many reluctances and dissatisfactions?"

Her dream of a shelter had completely turned into a bubble, and she was irritated because these idiots also made her unhappy.

"Do you still think you are the leader? If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have ended up where we are today! It's up to you to atone for your sins and dig them out!"

One person threw the shovel at Tian Manqi's feet and struck directly.

"You!"

Tian Manqi was very angry. Normally, this group of people was very obedient. No one dared to say anything wrong when she said something.

Why is it so difficult to get them to dig a hole now?

She forced herself to calm down and suppress the anger in her heart:

"I know you have resentment towards me, but the most important thing now is to save your life! We can only survive if we unite and dig a cave to withstand the high temperature."

The man who just threw the shovel looked at Tian Manqi with a smile:

"Okay, we can unite, but only if you dig first!"

Along the way, he saw that Tian Manqi always knew how to instruct others, but did nothing herself.
